source_policy: Only OPM and federal .gov sources are used. Agency and component aggregates are public OPM Federal Workforce Data rows; redacted public pay rows are not estimated.

snapshot.count_field_note: The OPM count field is 1 on every row in this employment release, so row count equals visible employee count for these aggregates.

definitions.agency_level: agency_code/agency fields from OPM FWD. Department of Defense is split into Army, Navy, Air Force, and DOD where OPM agency_code does so.
definitions.component_level: agency_subelement_code/agency_subelement fields from OPM FWD, used for bureaus and components such as FBI, OSHA, VHA, IRS, FAA, and TSA.
definitions.cost_metric: Sum of numeric annualized_adjusted_basic_pay for visible OPM rows. Redacted pay rows are excluded from dollar totals.
definitions.high_gs_definition: GS pay_plan_code rows with numeric grades 13, 14, or 15.
definitions.ses_definition: SES is pay_plan_code ES. A separate senior_pay_plan_count also includes ES, SL, and ST rows.
definitions.share_denominator: Percentages use all visible OPM rows in the agency/component, including rows whose pay amount is redacted.
